message: The app crashed during the update and now all of my mother's medication reminders are gone. She missed her evening insulin dose because of this. Fix this immediately.
I have been charged twice for my Premium subscription this month. I want the duplicate charge refunded right away.
How do I add a second caregiver to my father's profile? I want my sister to also get his alerts.
Just wanted to say the new medication tracking feature is fantastic. It has made caring for my grandmother so much easier. Thank you!
Emergency fall alerts are NOT reaching my phone. My dad fell yesterday and I received no notification at all. This is unacceptable for a health app.
I cannot log in. It keeps saying "invalid credentials" even after I reset my password twice. Please help.
Can I switch from monthly to annual billing? Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
How do I change the app language to Nepali? My mother is not comfortable reading English.
The pill scanner stopped recognising my father's medications after the latest update. It worked fine last week.
It would be great if the app could sync with my Apple Watch so I get reminders on my wrist.
Someone has accessed my account and changed my mother's health records without permission. I need this account locked down immediately.
The support agent who helped me last week was excellent and very patient. Really appreciate the great service.
The dashboard is very slow to load. It takes almost 30 seconds every single time I open the app.
I cancelled my subscription last month but you are STILL charging my card. This feels like fraud and I want it stopped now.
Where can I download my father's health report as a PDF to share with his doctor?
The reminder notifications arrive about 10 minutes late every time. Can this timing be fixed?
The video call with the doctor kept dropping and we could not finish the consultation. Very frustrating.
I love the new interface redesign. It is much easier for my grandmother to navigate on her own now.
Do you offer a family plan that covers multiple patients under one account?
All of my mother's health data has disappeared from the app. Months of blood pressure and glucose logs, gone. Please help urgently, we need that history for her appointment tomorrow.
